reviews.comment: I used to hold Professor Kulhanek in high regard; I no longer do so. She denied my peer the opportunity to attend a funeral of a friend who had unexpectedly passed away, and threatened a 0 if they didn't show up. In addition, she even stated that she was from the area and aware of the tragedy, yet still denied my peer the opportunity to attend.

Quite a bit of material, but she lays it out clearly. Super accessible outside of class and responded quickly through emails. Term paper at the end of the semester, but given ample time to get it done, and she does "guided studies," which are quizzes that you have to take off readings... but you get to use what you wrote for the term paper!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I love Dr. K! She is a smart and well respected lady. I have taken her 4 times and have learned a lot in her classes. You do need to be ready to put forth effort but it is worth it. She also gives great feedback and truly cares about her students.
Dr K is understanding. This class was a pass/fail so the workload was not crazy. She if good.

This class is required for transfer students, and all her assignments have to do with future careers, like building a resume and portfolio. She has guest lectures most weeks, which allows students to ask questions.

She is a very nice professor, and her class was very helpful. This class is required for transfer students, and all her assignments have to do with future careers, like building a resume and portfolio. She has guest lectures and allows students to ask questions. The class is pass/fail, but it is almost impossible to fail. She is a good resource!

This class has a hybrid schedule. We would go in person some weeks, and you would need an access code to take the attendance quiz. Other weeks, it was online, and no access code was required. It is an easy class that helps students transfer into COMM and JOUR.

Dr. K was a great professor! I took COMM 315 as a 5-week asynchronous summer course. The quizzes and exams are super duper easy. You do have to purchase PackBack, but can find the textbook free online. One essay assignment, but you can write about your favorite TV show or movie. She was very nice and caring! I would 10000% take her again.
She is one of the most helpful professors in the department. She is so funny, too! I wish I could take every Dr K class!

Dr. Kulhanek's lectures were a little dull because she just read off of the slides, but it was good information. Majority of your grade is from a group project, 2 test, and packbacks. If you put some effort in you should get an A.

Loved her and this class. We did a lecture every Monday and then on Wednesday she did "CLCM consults." You have a group project made up of 6-8 people and you get assigned a chapter in the book and you have to create a fake lecture on it. She is super fun and she is such a great prof/human. Just make sure you follow the rubric for all assignments!

Class was super easy! 4 group projects, 4 Quizzes, and a couple other random assignments for attendance and things. You do need to go to class for these, and do not interrupt her or leave because she will call you out in front of everyone. It was good though that she brought interesting guest speakers. Class was interesting. Take it!

Love her. She is always accessible outside of class and is very clear with what she expects from you. You do work with a group the entire semester so make sure you choose a good group. She also takes attendance every class.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Kulhanek's class was not too hard but it was the way that she graded the group work that was hard. The tests were also kind of hard and difficult to understand. We were only given 50 minutes to take an exam with 40 questions and 2 of them were essays (i.e. not enough time).

She is alright at lecturing ig, just as boring as the rest, the only thing is she has absolutely no leadership experience and she frames herself as someone who does while teaching the leadership course. The assignments are also super annoying as they're all either group projects or busy work. She is a pretty nice person though.
Such a great choice if she is one of the professors for the class you're looking for. I will take her any chance I get. 10/10 recommend!

I loved Dr. K!! She really really cares about each student and their success in the course. She is very open to helping you out, and she is extremely funny and real. I would take her over and over again, she makes it an easy A!
fun teacher, caring

I would definitely take her! I had her for COMM 210 and she was amazing in COMM 308 as well. She is super nice and is funny. She cares about her students and understands how much work to assign us. I highly recommend taking her.

Dr. K made a required Comm course actually enjoyable! There is a big research project, but she splits it up into assignments making it easier to understand how to do each part. She gives good feedback and if you didn't do great on one of the assignments you can resubmit it for late points. She's both funny & caring, I would def recommend her!
COMM 485, for transfers, is a pretty easy class even though it seems pretty mundane. Dr. K is the best though!

Prof K was amazing. This was my first Comm class since I am a transfer student and it was not difficult for me to figure out at all. She made all of the assignments understandable and I usually completed them the first day we got them assigned. The tests are difficult tho so be sure to study a little. I plan to take her whenever I can.

I loved being in Dr. K's COMM 210 course! Overall, it's pretty easy to get an A in - however, you do have to be on top of attendance, reading your textbook, and working with your team members consistently (make sure you pick good team members, you'll be working with them all semester). If you can do all of those things, you're set!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. K is by far my fav prof i've had. not only is she super funny but she's a great educator and answers all and any questions. 308 has weekly packbacks, usually one quiz a week, and a homework assignment. However, they are all 1000% doable as long as you pay attention to deadlines. attendance is not mandatory but i would strongly recommend going.

The grading system is not transparently described in the ecampus. The already-demanding assignments are awful because they're done in parts and you don't know what the next parts are going to be like until you've already completed the previous parts, meaning you're doing the entire project in the dark and without knowing how they'll fit together.

I took Professor K for comm 308 and she was really awesome. Weekly assignments and packbacks keep you engaged with your classmates and are graded easily. She has a GroupMe for the class and always responds super fast and is there to help. All in all the class was a lot more fun than I expected and I would definitely take her again.

Professor Kulhanek was a great professor. I had her for COMM 485 too and she was very funny. I highly recommend taking her if you need to take either of these courses. The exams are tough, but the projects are very easy. I suggest picking your group members wisely, since you will be spending a lot of time outside of class with them.

Kulhanek used to be an academic advisor so she really knows her stuff. She gives great feedback and works to build relationships with her students. I will be taking her 210 course next semester. Biggest help was that she created a group me for our class for any questions we had. Quick responses from her too. One of the best profs I've ever had.

She actually cares about her students and is there to help them. You actually have to do work and meet with your group outside of class time. Her exams can be difficult so pay attention in class and read the textbook but she is very understanding when it comes to grading.

I took her for COMM210. She is a great professor that loves to build relationships with her students! It is important to show up to class, take good notes, and choose your group wisely at the begging of the semester. This class really taught me a lot. Show up to class, and stay on top of your term project! I am hoping to be able to take her again.
great prof, take her!!
